en: An old, colorized postcard showing a riverside view with trees and a fence in the foreground and a townscape with church spires across the water in the background. The printed caption under the image reads "Gezicht van Nijmegen op Lent." The card is heavily speckled with age and has dense handwritten cursive text in Dutch both below the picture and vertically along the left margin.
